note: UI Editor views stage 2: the customised mark and Reset to Desktop view. H01 to H14; the prefix H is used by no earlier spec file. retiredChecks and amendments apply to the real page and --stub13 only. Truth values come from the engine's export of the edit lists below, loaded in plain Chromium (validate-views2.mjs), never from the page.

vocabulary.note: as specs-views1-nonudge.json and specs-views1-nudge2.json, plus: step snapshotList {name} (the page's effective edit list, as data-edit-list gives it, kept), step snapshotBar {name} (the boxes of the three view buttons, kept), step focusControl {name} also names a button of the bar; assert viewButtons {desktop, tablet, phone, tip?}: for each view button, whether it is customised (its accessible name is 'Phone, customised' and a mark element is drawn; otherwise the plain name and no mark) and, with tip, whether its tooltip says customised; assert viewButtonBoxes {against, tol}; assert resetButton {present, enabled?, tipHas?} (the button whose accessible name is 'Reset to Desktop view'); assert dialog {open, has?, buttons?} (the Confirm group); assert listIs {snapshot} (the effective list now equals the snapshot); assert exportEqualsFiltered {snapshot, env} (the engine replays the snapshot list with every set, offset and reorder of that environment taken out, by the runner's own filter, and its files equal the page's export); assert layoutBaseline {width, view, baseline}. A name given for a view button in a view, viewPressed, device or barNames step may be the plain name or the name followed by ', customised'. See docs/ui-editor-gate-rules-views2.md section 4.

specs.name: The customised mark is absent at load in Desktop, Tablet and Phone and in both orientations, after a Desktop edit (seen from every view), and after Insert, Text, Delete and a Note made in Phone

The mark appears on the Phone button only after a Phone edit and on the Tablet button only after a Tablet edit; the button's name is 'Phone, customised' and its tooltip says so; the buttons keep their size and place
The mark follows Undo, Redo and Reset all, and belongs to the view, not the orientation: it shows in upright and sideways Phone and Tablet alike

The Reset to Desktop view button: not in Desktop; in Tablet and Phone, upright or sideways; disabled with no changes of its own and its tooltip says why; enabled with some and its tooltip says what it does; an SVG has no environments so it is disabled there and says so

tipHas: Reset the Tablet view to the Desktop setup
Reset the Phone view to the Desktop setup
Reset the Phone view to the Desktop setup
text, inserted items and notes stay
an SVG has no separate Phone changes
an SVG has no separate Tablet changes

specs.name: The confirm dialog names the view, says only that view changes, that Desktop and the other small view are untouched, that text, inserted items and notes stay and that Undo brings the changes back; Cancel changes nothing (list and bytes) and the focus goes back to the Reset button

has: Reset the Phone view to the Desktop setup?
removes the changes made in Phone only
Desktop and the other small view are untouched
text, inserted items and notes stay
Reset the Tablet view to the Desktop setup?
removes the changes made in Tablet only

specs.name: Reset in Phone: with a Desktop edit (headline 60), a Phone edit (20), a Tablet edit (30) and a Phone text edit, Confirm puts the Phone range back to the Desktop-scaled 40.9091 px (measured in plain Chromium), leaves Desktop 60 and Tablet 30 alone, keeps the text, and the export equals the engine's export of the list with the Phone edits filtered out

steps.text: Phone view reset to the Desktop setup

specs.name: Reset in Tablet: the same with the Tablet edit gone: the Tablet range is back to Desktop 60 px, Desktop 60 and Phone 20 are untouched, the text stays, and the export equals the engine's export of the filtered list

steps.text: Tablet view reset to the Desktop setup

specs.name: Reset Phone leaves an earlier and a later Desktop edit in force; one Undo restores the exact bytes and the mark, one Redo re-applies the reset; a Desktop edit after it joins the list

The long mixed sequence: edit A in Phone, edit B in Desktop, reset Phone, edit C, then Undo, Undo, Undo, Redo, Redo, Redo give the exact bytes of the states in between, the edit count, Undo and Redo and the mark stay right, the engine's replay of the final list equals the export, and Reset all still clears everything

Reset in sideways (view-only) Phone and Tablet: the button works there (decided: the view's changes belong to the view, not the orientation); the Phone range, then the Tablet range, are back to the Desktop-scaled values in the export and the upright preview

No flash on a view reset, or on Undo and Redo of it: the old preview stays until the new one is ready (no frame without a visible preview, one preview iframe at rest, the scroll and the stage height unchanged)

Keyboard: the Reset button is in the bar's tab order right after Rotate, opens the dialog with Enter and with Space, Keep editing (the dialog's first focus) closes it and the focus goes back to the Reset button

The layout is as it was apart from the one new button: at 1000, 1280, 1440 and 1920 px in Desktop, Tablet and Phone no ribbon group moves (0.5 px), the bar has the same number of rows and the same height, every button that was there keeps its size, the Desktop bar has no new button and the Tablet and Phone bar gain the Reset button (the changes in x are reported)
Flag OFF: the build without VITE_SHOW_UI_EDITOR behaves exactly as before (flags.mjs, 16 of 16) and every file of that build except the UiEditor chunks is byte for byte the main build's
